headline: Malaga are bottom, Alaves winless — the market still favours the hosts
summary: Malaga arrive in Vitoria bottom of La Liga: 20th, 4 points, no win this season, and beaten 5-2 at home by Real Sociedad last Saturday. Alaves have problems of their own — no win in their last 5 — but the market still makes them 54.9% favourites, a fair chance averaged across 10 bookmakers with their margin removed. The goals line is 2.25, with over priced at 53.1%: a narrow home win, and goals just more likely than not.
read: Malaga come to Vitoria bottom of La Liga and still without a win, and the market makes Alaves 54.9% favourites and about three-quarters of a goal the better side — even though Alaves have lost four of their last five. The total sits at 2.25 with a slight lean to Over, matching a Malaga side that has conceded 11 goals in five matches but also scored in three of them.

facts.fact: Alaves are 54.9% favourites to win, more than two and a half times Malaga's 19.4%.
facts.meaning: The market makes Alaves more likely than not to take all three points at home.

facts.fact: Malaga are bottom of La Liga with 4 points from nine games and a goal difference of -12.
facts.meaning: They arrive in Vitoria as the worst-placed side in the division, which is the base of their 19.4% away chance.

facts.fact: Malaga were beaten 5-2 at home by Real Sociedad on 18 October.
facts.meaning: They conceded five at home a week before this trip — the low point of a run of 11 goals let in over five games.

facts.fact: Alaves have not won in five: LLDLL, scoring three goals and conceding seven in that run.
facts.meaning: The favourites are on a poor run of their own — this is not a confident home side.

facts.fact: The main handicap line is Alaves -0.75.
Malaga have averaged 0.70 xG created and 1.94 conceded over their last five games.
Alaves' -0.75 handicap price firmed from 46.9% to 48.8% fair probability in recent days.
facts.meaning: Money came in on Alaves covering the handicap, though the move is small rather than decisive.

facts.fact: The goals line is 2.25, with Over priced at 53.1%.
facts.meaning: The market leans slightly towards more than two goals, but not strongly — it does not see a rout.

sources.fact: Alaves lost 2-1 away to Celta Vigo in La Liga, a result that lifted Celta to eighth in the table.
Alaves are due to face Barcelona at home in La Liga on October 31.
Alaves players not selected for other squads could be called up by the Basque Country national team for their November friendly at San Mames.
Cadena SER reports that Malaga's Joaquin Munoz has a right soleus muscle injury and is expected to miss Friday's La Liga clash against Alaves.
Malaga were beaten 5-2 at home by Real Sociedad in La Liga on October 18.
Takefusa Kubo scored a goal and added an assist against Malaga on his first start since September.
The match is La Liga's tenth round fixture, with Malaga visiting Vitoria to face Alaves at Mendizorroza.
